_meta.description: Proposed test-design cases — not executed fixtures or passing results.

cases.description: Deterministic interleaving: lexical-first, duplicates removed, stops at the chunk limit

expected_result.rule: alternate lexical-first, remove duplicates, stop at limit; expanding any selected node still respects the same total limit

cases.description: Lexical fallback reaches newly committed content while indexing is pending, with degraded coverage disclosed

operations.note: indexing left pending — index() not called

cases.expected_result: lexical evidence reaches the committed message; coverage.index_degraded=true disclosed

cases.description: No evidence found: synthesis makes zero calls, explicit null answer

operations.query: a question with no supporting evidence anywhere in the history

cases.description: Invalid citations are structurally rejected; a repair-then-still-invalid answer is suppressed
cases.expected_result: after at most one allowed repair attempt, a still-invalid answer is suppressed with invalid_answer diagnostics — never returned to the caller
cases.note: a real but irrelevant quote is a semantic-support evaluation concern, not proof that structural validation established relevance — these are measured separately
